name: dino-community-launcher
description: Dino Community desktop launcher for The Isle with server query, game monitoring, system tray, module management, upstream isle-overlay HUD and automatic updates.

scripts.check: node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.js && node --check electron/services/config-service.js && node --check electron/services/game-service.js && node --check electron/services/server-service.js && node --check electron/services/updater-service.js && node --check electron/services/logger-service.js && node --check electron/services/module-manager.js && node --check electron/services/tray-service.js && node --check src/renderer.js && node --check src/settings-ui.js && node --check modules/hud/index.js && node --check modules/hud/host-preload.js && node --check scripts/prepare-upstream-hud.js
scripts.publish: npm run hud:prepare && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always

author: Dino Community
